title: feyt pack
description: Increase FPS and make your minecraft easier to work with this pack!
body:
**For this build (including builds above 1.20.5) need Java 1.21 https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase/jdk21-archive-downloads.html**

_This pack should make it easier for your game to work. It contains a small number of mods that are suitable for playing on the server, in the local world. This is my first pack, criticism is accepted!)_

**Write here https://vk.com/reyzov_xx**

Basic Mods:

Sodium (**a new mod aimed at improving the performance of the game, significantly increasing FPS in Minecraft.**)

Very Many Players (**A Fabric mod designed to improve server performance at high playercounts.**)

IrisMod (**An open source Sodium-based mod that adds support for existing shaders to a game with Sodium installed. The author declares support for existing shaders that are focused on Optifine.**)

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (**It is designed to improve the performance of generating game chunks of the world, improve and speed up the loading and unloading of chunks, which should have a positive effect on the performance of the game, especially with a large number of installed mods.**)
